0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The stern Hhetsarro has something both pointy and poignant for you to deliver.

24.original: Deliver the polished horn to the spirited Hhetsarro.

26.original: Deliver the fresh vegetables to the stern Hhetsarro.

48.original: Hail, traveler. If you're bound for Hhusatahwi, I have a favor to ask.

49.original: Could I get you to deliver this polished horn to my sister?

50.original: You'll find her tending the field on the outskirts of town. She shouldn't be hard to recognize─we have the same hair color.

51.original: Please make sure that polished horn gets to my sister in Hhusatahwi. Keep an eye out for a Hhetsarro farmer with the same color hair as me.

52.original: Oho, what can I do for you?

53.original: Ah, this horn... I knew the day would come, but it's sad to think he's no longer with us.

54.original: I appreciate the delivery, nonetheless! I hate to ask any more of you, but there's something I want to give to my sister in return.

55.original: Harvest a handful of vegetables from that plant and take them to her, would you?

56.original: I know I ought to do it myself, but the crops won't tend themselves... Anyway, tell her that I'll come and visit soon!

58.original: Welcome back, traveler. Ah, but what is that you have there?

59.original: So fresh and plump... These look delicious. Clearly my sister's been hard at work.

60.original: I suppose you're wondering why I had you deliver that horn. It came from an old rroneek bull that recently passed away. He was our hhetso─one of many creatures we Hhetsarro seek guidance from throughout our lives.

61.original: My sister and I─our souls are bound together through that rroneek. So too in death, as much as in life.

62.original: One horn I gave to my sister, the other horn I keep with me. It struck me as a fitting symbol of the connection. I'm sure she understood.

63.original: She may have moved to Hhusatahwi, but she's still Hhetsarro. Nothing will ever change that.

64.original: Anyway, judging by your message, I can expect a visit from her any day now. I should prepare a feast to welcome her back home.

65.original: Thank you, traveler. We sisters were fortunate to have met you.
